originalGate.section: FXC-06 — Time, Endurance and true work

completeOriginalRequirement: Exercise both Endurance cause counters with actual24-hour provisioning, unpaid Rest Debt deadline, later missed Rest Watch, safe8-hour rest, unrelated shortage and suppression/acquisition events. Preserve existing debt/Strain/history, two-work-Watch ceiling and unsupported-day restrictions. Validate one genuine forage Watch, actual animal/person needs, no Supply conversion from missing oil/sundries, all time-discount compositions and entire≤30-minute rest repair versus a partial tail of a long job.

areas.completeSubmittedMeaning: Actual active Watch, completed-use cadence, finite sites, separate person/animal needs, no missing oil/sundry conversion or invented Supply.
areas.reason: A genuine 480-active-minute Watch, finite-site depletion, incompatible interruption, completion+1440-minute cadence, separate person/mule demands, carry quantities, container prerequisites and no oil/sundry/Supply creation are all explicitly represented. Acquisition is a paid source-qualified slice, not a grant of provisions or a campaign character.
areas.illustration: FP83-02 credits 480 active minutes across [0,240] and [270,510], completes at510, depletes actual finite food/water and sets next allowed completion1950. FP83-07 uses actual14lb food and40pints for two people plus a mule, leaving16pints water; it manufactures no oil/sundries.

areas.area: Endurance, rest debt and cause counters
areas.completeSubmittedMeaning: Separate food/water and sleep credits; debt deadline/later missed Watch/safe rest; old Strain and history preserved; suppression and unavailable cause credits; no third work Watch.
areas.reason: The two pending cause counters, unsupported-day history, unpaid debt deadline and later missed Watch, exact and late safe-rest completion, no second beneficial-rest reward inside24hours, cause-specific suppression, unrelated logistics, previous Strain, duplicate-event records and two-work-Watch ceiling are distinguished.
areas.illustration: FP83-10 separately assesses foodWater at1440, sleep debt at2400, a later missed Rest Watch at2880 and that day's foodWater assessment; final Strain2 and debt remain. FP83-11 completes real safe rest at the exact2400 deadline; FP83-12 retains already-incurred penalties when rest ends late. This does not execute a global scheduler.

areas.completeSubmittedMeaning: Old arithmetic assumes genuinely eligible creation. FT84-Q03 now resolves which named procedures qualify; no source case required numerical replacement.
areas.reason: Existing manufacturing arithmetic and phases are preserved. The accepted source-authorized-creation predicate resolves Contraption versus Trapsetter versus explicit temper/kill-zone exclusions. Actual stock, committed uses, interruption, failed completed attempts, physically usable partial work, separate waits and recipe121 labor are retained.
areas.illustration: Discounted Contraption is a whole five-minute uninterrupted job; an interrupted attempt keeps its committed part/use losses. Trapsetter retains only actual usable assembly work. Recipe121 work credit does not itself award successful manufacturing output or XP.

areas.completeSubmittedMeaning: FT84-Q02 adds only the two named process clocks and real final remainder; actual exclusions/waits and work caps remain.
areas.reason: Source minimum and strongest applicable time factor precede the named-project phase clock. Exact final fractional work, actual interrupted-phase loss, assistant eligibility, evidence/access/retry and work-Watch exclusions are represented. Teaching/manufacturing clocks are not generalized.
areas.illustration: The two named research processes receive completed15-minute phases plus their exact final remainder. A real progress-loss cause remains an independent premise; other research clocks and fixed waits remain outside this completion.

areas.area: Spell copying, written ritual learning and material bills
areas.completeSubmittedMeaning: FT84-Q01 selects true complete written copying versus teaching; original mixed/unclassified bill arithmetic remains conditional; current six full procedures control.
areas.reason: Full written ritual-copy access versus teacher-led learning, optional advisory tutoring, genuine unitemized full-price stock, actual mundane/rare/unique bill categories, rounding, real book/language, interruption and Wizard source-specific scribing are all represented.
areas.illustration: WC84-11 rejects an unsupported material-discount classification, not a lawful full-price copy. FT84-01-ambiguous-full-price retains the independent half-time benefit; no original numeric result needs replacement.

areas.area: Ritual casting composition and true helpers
areas.completeSubmittedMeaning: Real casting base/floor/non-worsening rule and actual distinct participating bodies; no extra helpers or learning/copying benefit inferred.
areas.reason: The actual base labor, source-added ritual labor, Quick Ritualist non-worsening floor, single actual group adjustment, source-required helpers/caps and separate waits are represented independently. No learning permission, assistant, numerical roll bonus or physical body is created by this time arithmetic.
areas.illustration: An actual shorter addition is not lengthened by a five-minute reduction floor; one holder does not become two physical people or count as lead and assistant at once.

areas.completeSubmittedMeaning: Gossip active inquiry versus calendar appointments; specific armor/helper multiplication retains its own scope.
areas.reason: Local inquiry active time is separated from calendar appointments, truth and contact access. Armor's actual helper exception and final interval completion remain source-specific, not a universal multiplicative rule.
areas.illustration: The local inquiry's1440-minute appointment wait is unchanged. Armor's explicitly permitted Battle Ready/helper composition does not change a shield's one-Action cost or allow arbitrarily many helpers.

areas.area: Whole short rest repairs and long-job tails
areas.completeSubmittedMeaning: Whole eligible20/30-minute repairs versus31/480-minute jobs; actual completion, stock, remaining HP, source qualifications and replay protection.
areas.reason: The whole <=30-active-minute repair is distinguished from a short tail of a long job. Actual authorized procedure/body/trade/tools/rest premise, completion, stock, current-HP cap, failures, repeat completion and spent service/charges/fuel are all retained.
areas.illustration: The complete20/30-minute repairs qualify for the narrow exception; a31-minute repair and the last20minutes of480-minute reconstruction do not. No charge, service or fuel is restored with structural HP.

sourceVsWorldBoundary: Covered means complete finite authored evidence at its exact stated premises, not live-world authentication, production code or an exhaustive cross-product of every possible event ordering.
